svg.text: Built for latency: one task finishes fast
Built for throughput: a million tasks finish fast
each square = one dumb lane. Real GPUs: 10,000+.
One matmul C = A @ B — every cell is an independent dot product
a dot product — the Day-12 neuron — needs no
→ each C cell gets its own GPU lane: perfect fan-out,
like sharding one query across 10,000 partitions.
Result: matmul is the most shardable workload in computing — and the GPU is the shard fleet.
